title: Reset your password
body: Open the sign-in page, choose Forgot password, and follow the email link. The link lasts 15 minutes. If no email arrives within five minutes, open an access ticket; IT never asks for your current password.

title: Connect to the VPN
body: Install the VPN client from the software portal, sign in with your company account, and pick the nearest gateway. If it says certificate expired, update the client first.

title: Request a new laptop or replacement
body: Laptops are ordered by IT, not expensed. Open a hardware ticket with the model you need and why. Standard replacement cycle is four years.

title: Report a phishing email
body: Do not click links. Use the Report button in the mail client, or forward the message as an attachment to the security mailbox, then delete it. If you clicked, open a security ticket at once.

title: Get access to a shared drive or repo
body: Access is granted by the owner of the resource. Open an access ticket naming the resource and the owner; IT applies it once the owner approves.

title: Printer setup
body: Add the office printer from the printers list in system settings. Drivers install automatically on the office network.
